title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-92-24一模

items.zh: 边喝咖啡边欣赏上海夜最多惬意呀!
items.en: How pleasant it is to enjoy the night views of Shanghai while drinking coffee.

items.zh: 这个案例太复杂，一时半会解释不清楚。
items.en: The case is too complex to explain clearly in a short while.

items.zh: 中美领导人在旧金山会晤，意义非凡，吸引了世界的关注，推动了中美关系的发展。
items.en: The meeting between Chinese and American leaders in San Francisco is of great importance, drawing worldwide attention and promoting the development of bilateral relations.

items.zh: 只有坚持理想和信念，并做好失败的准备，一切看起来不可能战胜的因难终将迎刃而解。
items.en: Only by adhering to our ideals and beliefs and bracing for failure will all difficulties that seem insurmountable be resolved/overcome.
